steps.now: The palace needs a ticket booked online in your own name. Ask 王阿姨 at home — she books everything on her phone.
steps.past: 王阿姨 booked my palace ticket on her phone.

steps.now: Go to 天安门 (line 1 to 天安门东), cross the bridge and walk through the gate; show your passport at the security check.
steps.past: Showed my passport at the security check and walked into the palace.

steps.now: Walk north through 午门 to the Hall of Supreme Harmony 太和殿.
steps.past: Walked north through 午门 to the Hall of Supreme Harmony.

steps.now: 兔儿爷 feels the last spirit at the Nine-Dragon Screen 九龙壁, east of 太和殿's square.
steps.past: Met the last spirit, the dragon, at the Nine-Dragon Screen.

steps.now: Walk to the Imperial Garden 御花园 — west of 太和殿's square. The spirits are waiting for you there.
steps.past: Found all the spirits waiting in the Imperial Garden.
